headline: Get Eko
title: How to Get Eko | Forest of Falling Stars | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Eko is a small Wind Aniimo you find in the Forest of Falling Stars, mostly in the north under stone outcroppings, at levels twenty to twenty five. To evolve it into Eklue you need two things. Reach level twenty five, and make sure its acquired attack potential is six or higher. Potential cannot be changed, so catch a few Eko and compare. Did you roll a good one? Comment below!
description: Eko lives in the Forest of Falling Stars (levels 20-25) and evolves into Eklue at level 25 with acquired ATK Potential of 6 or higher.
